neoscinematicvanilla.config.title: Neo's Cinematic Vanilla
neoscinematicvanilla.option.biomes.enabl: Lets deserts, swamps, forests and peaks each feel different. Off makes everywhere behave like ordinary ground.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.biomes.stren: How far each kind of place departs from ordinary ground. 0 makes everywhere the same, higher exaggerates the contrast.
Deserts, badlands and savannas: sandy dust in the air, warm haze, and the least shelter from wind.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.biomes.froze: Anywhere snow falls: pale cold air and scattered motes that read as blown snow.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.biomes.swamp: Swamps: the heaviest fog and the stillest air in the game.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.biomes.woode: Forest, taiga and jungle: sheltered from wind, with shafts of motes under the canopy.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.biomes.highl: Peaks and windswept hills: thin clear air and the strongest wind.
Master switch for fog. Off leaves Minecraft's own fog completely untouched.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.intensit: Scales every fog effect below at once. The quickest way to dial the whole system up or down.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.altitude: Haze that builds in low ground and clears as you climb. Vanilla does nothing with altitude.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.cave.too: How thick the air gets underground. The strongest everyday effect in the mod.
Extra fog during rain and thunderstorms, on top of what Minecraft already does.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.end_dist: How opaque fog becomes at the edge of your view distance. Higher is thicker overall.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.start_di: How close fog begins. Higher pushes it further away and keeps nearby ground clear.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.dawn_mis: Mist that gathers around sunrise and burns off through the morning. Pools in valleys, thin on peaks.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.dusk_haz: Haze that settles around sunset. Milder and longer lasting than dawn.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.night_ha: Gentle haze through the small hours.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.transiti: How quickly fog reacts when your surroundings change. Lower is smoother and stops fog snapping at a cave mouth.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.haze_ful: At or below this height, altitude haze is at full strength.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.haze_non: At or above this height, altitude haze is gone entirely.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.cave_ful: At or below this height, an enclosed space counts fully as underground.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.cave_non: Above this height, enclosed spaces are treated as buildings and stay clear. Raise it and your house will fog up.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.override: Also change fog in dimensions that define their own, such as the Nether. Off by default so authored looks are preserved.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.fog.debug.to: Writes fog density and distances to the game log. For tuning, not for play.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.en: Master switch for the motes that drift in the air.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.de: Scales every mote source at once.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.ca: Dust hanging in caves and other deep enclosed spaces.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.su: Motes in open air. Their colour, shape and rate follow the character of the biome you are in.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.op: How visible each mote is at its brightest.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.mo: How large individual motes are drawn.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.li: How long a mote lasts before fading out. Longer lifetimes mean more motes on screen at once.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.fa: How long a mote takes to fade in and out. Stops them appearing and vanishing abruptly.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.dr: How fast motes move on their own, before wind is applied.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.sh: How many motes appear together in one group.
How far a group of motes extends downward.
How widely motes scatter. Narrow reads as a shaft of light, wide reads as haze.
How far a group leans from vertical. 0 makes every group stand upright.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.particles.de: Writes how many motes are being spawned per second to the game log.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.leaves.enabl: Master switch for falling leaves. Minecraft already drops these; this only changes how often.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.leaves.frequ: Scales Minecraft's own leaf fall rate. 1 leaves it untouched, 0 stops it, higher makes forests busier.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.enabled: Master switch for wind, which drives the ambient sound and moves motes and leaves together.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.strengt: Scales wind everywhere. Affects sound, motes and leaves at once.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.exposur: How much shelter matters. At 1 a forest floor is nearly still and a peak is fully exposed. At 0 wind ignores your surroundings.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.weather: How much rain and thunder raise the wind.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.gustine: Depth of the slow rise and fall in strength. 0 gives perfectly steady wind.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.directi: How quickly the wind changes direction.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.sound_e: Master switch for the ambient wind loop.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.sound_v: How loud wind gets at full strength.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.sound_t: Wind below this strength is silent. Stops a constant faint hiss indoors and in sheltered places.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.mote_in: How strongly wind carries drifting motes.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.leaf_in: How strongly wind carries falling leaves.
neoscinematicvanilla.option.wind.debug.t: Writes wind strength, direction and exposure to the game log.
Film grain over the world, strongest in shadows and never over menus. Off by default. Shader packs disable it.
